title: TicketSubmissionPrincipalV1
description: SPEC-UA-021 (Ticket Submission Principal Contract). Independently authored from 02-ticket-workflow's own real, checked-in claim-extraction code (services/ticket-workflow-service PublicTicketController#createTicket) rather than imported from anything this service (user-access-authentication-service) itself produces — a drift between what domain 01 issues/accepts and what domain 02's real code reads must show up here as a real test failure, not as two copies of the same possibly-wrong assumption agreeing with each other. This is the access-token CLAIM SET a caller must present to successfully submit a ticket: `sub` becomes 02's own requesterId, `azp`/`client_id` becomes its clientId, `scope` is read for the SCOPE_tickets:create authority check. Deliberately does NOT require a `tickets:create` scope value itself -- which scopes a token carries is Keycloak/domain-02's own authorization concern, never something domain 01's own JWT acceptance may depend on (02-business-invariants: domain boundaries).

sub.description: 02-ticket-workflow API-001: 'For an employee request, requesterId comes from the JWT' -- PublicTicketController#createTicket reads this directly as jwt.getSubject().

iss.description: Must be the same trusted issuer both services validate the access token against.
